# has manifestation format

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasManifestationFormat`](gmeow-hasManifestationFormat.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasManifestationFormat>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/creative-works`](../../slices/creative-works.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The physical or digital format of this manifestation — hardcover, EPUB, audiobook, web serial, etc. A value from the open [`gmeow:ManifestationFormat`](../classes/gmeow-ManifestationFormat.md) vocabulary.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Manifestation`](../classes/gmeow-Manifestation.md) -> [`gmeow:ManifestationFormat`](../classes/gmeow-ManifestationFormat.md); functional

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to record the format of a [`Manifestation`](../classes/gmeow-Manifestation.md) — the publishable form (paperback, EPUB, audiobook, vinyl). Functional: one format per [`Manifestation`](../classes/gmeow-Manifestation.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid asserting it on a [`Work`](../classes/gmeow-Work.md), [`Expression`](../classes/gmeow-Expression.md), or [`Item`](../classes/gmeow-Item.md) (format is a Manifestation-tier fact) and avoid more than one value — a second format is a second [`Manifestation`](../classes/gmeow-Manifestation.md).

### How to use

- Point the [`Manifestation`](../classes/gmeow-Manifestation.md) at one [`gmeow:ManifestationFormat`](../classes/gmeow-ManifestationFormat.md) individual; model the physical substrate of a copy separately via [`gmeow:hasCarrier`](gmeow-hasCarrier.md) and [`gmeow:medium`](gmeow-medium.md).

### Examples

- ex:penguin2003 [`gmeow:hasManifestationFormat`](gmeow-hasManifestationFormat.md) [`gmeow:formatPaperback`](../individuals/gmeow-formatPaperback.md).
